name: figma
description: Access Figma designs, files, comments, and collaborate on design projects

envVars.name: FIGMA_CLIENT_ID
envVars.description: Figma OAuth Client ID (from your app settings)

setupGuide.title: Figma setup

steps.title: Choose who owns the Figma OAuth app
steps.description: On hosted Veryfront, Figma uses the Veryfront-managed Figma OAuth app: connect Figma from the project's integrations and approve the Figma consent screen, no environment variables needed. Set FIGMA_CLIENT_ID and FIGMA_CLIENT_SECRET only to use your own Figma OAuth app, which is required for local and self-hosted runs.

steps.title: Create an OAuth app
steps.description: In Figma, open My Apps and create a new app for your team or organization.

steps.title: Set the redirect URLs and scopes
steps.description: Select the scopes current_user:read, file_content:read, file_comments:read and file_comments:write. Add the redirect URI of the environment that completes the flow: https://api.veryfront.com/oauth/callback/figma for hosted Veryfront, or your app origin followed by /api/auth/figma/callback for a local or self-hosted app. Set FIGMA_CLIENT_ID and FIGMA_CLIENT_SECRET from the app's credentials.

steps.title: Publish the app
steps.description: While the app is a draft, only you and your plan admins can authorize it. Publish it privately for your team or organization, or publicly after Figma's review, so other users can connect.

steps.title: Verify access
steps.description: Run Get Me (read-only). It returns the connected Figma user without changing anything.

notes: The connection requests current_user:read, file_content:read, file_comments:read and file_comments:write. file_comments:write is only needed by the tool that posts comments.
Tools that create, update, send or delete data are marked as writes and need write authority; the other tools are read-only.

tools.name: Get Me
tools.description: Get the authenticated user's Figma profile (id, email, handle). Use this to verify the connection and identify the user.

tools.name: Get File
tools.description: Get detailed information about a Figma file, including pages, frames, components, and styles. Requires a Figma file key from a file or design URL.

geometry.description: Set to paths to export vector data

tools.name: Get Comments
tools.description: Get all comments on a Figma file

tools.name: Post Comment
tools.description: Post a comment on a Figma file

prompts.title: Review a design
prompts.prompt: Review a Figma design file and provide feedback on the components, layout, and design system usage.

prompts.title: Summarize comments
prompts.prompt: Read all comments on a Figma file and summarize the feedback, action items, and unresolved discussions.

prompts.title: Extract components
prompts.prompt: List all components in a Figma file and describe their structure, variants, and properties.

prompts.title: Give design feedback
prompts.prompt: Review the design file and post constructive feedback as comments on specific elements.
